member.name: M:DealOrForce.Rules.PeaceRules.StalemateDiscount(System.Int32,System.Boolean,System.Boolean,System.Single,System.Single)
member.summary:
The stalemate discount a long, tiring or already-stalled war applies to the winner's resolve over an achievable war aim.
Pulled out of `PeaceNegotiation.WarAimResolve` as a pure function of five numbers, because that is what it always was: time since the war began, whether the term on the table is a return to the status quo, whether the front has stalled, how weary both sides are, and how much of the responder's ground is occupied. The surrounding method still decides *whether* the penalty applies at all - that needs the campaign - but the arithmetic is here, where a wrong sign or a missing clamp is a compile-time absence rather than a number nobody notices for a year.
Float32 throughout, in the same order as the C# it replaces: a differential harness compares the two over a grid and requires exact equality, so the order matters.

member.name: M:DealOrForce.Rules.WarRhythmRules.GuerrillaCover(System.Single,System.Single,System.Single)
member.summary: How much ground a side fighting the war of the weak can hide in, 0 to 1: how lopsided the war is against it (asymmetry), how rough the province is (roughness), and whether it is fighting among its own people (homeGround) - each 0 to 1. The Hussites behind their wagons, the Taliban in the valleys: neither term alone, both together.

member.name: M:DealOrForce.Rules.WarRhythmRules.FightingSpirit(System.Single,System.Single,System.Single,System.Single,System.Single,System.Single,System.Single,System.Single)
member.summary: A side's fighting spirit in one year of a war: steady at 1 +/- spread, triangular - and, for a few, the year it turns out to be something nobody counted on. surpriseChance of them fight far above their weight (Finland in 1939, Ukraine in 2022) by surpriseSwing; collapseChance of them break (the Afghan army in 2021, Iraq's in Mosul in 2014) by collapseSwing. tailRoll decides which, once per side and year.

member.name: M:DealOrForce.Rules.WarRhythmRules.DesertionRate(System.Single,System.Single,System.Single,System.Single,System.Single,System.Single,System.Single,System.Single)
member.summary: The share of a formation's soldiers who desert in a week, 0 to cap: base times the square of the pressure on them - a war nobody at home believes in (1 - warSupport), a unit that has stopped being one (1 - cohesion), hunger below half supply, the shock of a broken line below 0.3 organisation, pay that has stopped (unpaid, 0 or 1), and a side whose spirit has gone below its own weight. A well-fed army in a popular war loses nobody.
